verdict.rationale: macOS offers Siri voice/natural-language commands and Spotlight for search-and-act without opening apps, plus Shortcuts automation, but these are limited to predefined actions/apps rather than open-ended natural-language operation of the whole OS (no agentic LLM assistant is documented). Missing for 10: evidence of a general-purpose AI assistant that can perform arbitrary system tasks via natural language, hands-on validation of Siri/Spotlight command coverage, and independent confirmation of reliability.
